parameters.query: SELECT a.id, a.date, a.time, s.name as servicio, u.name as cliente, u.email, u.phone FROM appointments a JOIN services s ON a.service_id = s.id JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE a.date = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND a.status IN ('PENDIENTE', 'CONFIRMADA')
